messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Portuguese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Portuguese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
No meio do caminho da nossa vida encontrei‑me numa selva escura, pois a via direita estava perdida.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG] After the table, list any MISSING or WRONG items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Portuguese) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|-----------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | **Nel** | prepositional phrase head “in the middle of” | **No** | “in the” | OK | | **mezzo** | noun, the middle point of a journey | **meio** | “middle” | OK | | **del** | preposition linking “cammin” to “vita” (genitive) | **do** | “of the” | OK | | **cammin** | noun “road, path” | **caminho** | “road” | OK | | **di** | preposition linking “nostra” to “vita” (genitive) | **da** | “of the” | OK | | **nostra** | possessive adjective “our” | **nossa** | “our” | OK | | **vita** | noun “life” | **vida** | “life” | OK | | **mi** | reflexive object of “ritrovai” (self) | **me** (part of *encontrei‑me*) | “myself” | OK | | **ritrovai** | main verb “found” (passato remoto) | **encontrei** | “found” | OK | | **per** | locative preposition “within, in” | **em** (implicit in *numa*) | “in/within” | OK | | **una** | indefinite article “a” | **uma** | “a” | OK | | **selva** | noun “forest, wood” | **selva** | “forest/wood” | OK | | **oscura** | adjective “dark” | **escura** | “dark” | OK | | **ché** | causal conjunction “for, because” | **pois** | “for” | OK | | **la** | definite article “the” | **a** | “the” | OK | | **diritta** | adjective “right, straight (correct way)” | **direita** | “right” | OK | | **via** | noun “way, road” | **via** | “way” | OK | | **era** | copular verb “had been, was” (imperfect) | **estava** | “was” | OK | | **smarrita** | predicate adjective “lost, missed” | **perdida** | “lost” | OK |

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING or WRONG items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words.
